full_judgment:
Md. Ruhul Quddus, J: This Rule Nisi, at the instance of a judgment debtor in a mortgage decree, was issued calling in question order dated 30.5.2005 passed in Artha Rin Execution Case No. 741 of 2003 pending in Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong and also the entire proceedings in the said execution case. 

 Facts leading to this writ petition, in short, are that Agrani Bank, Laldighi East Branch, Chittagong as plaintiff instituted Mortgage Suit No.107 of 1991 before the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong Sadar against the petitioner and others for realisation of loan amounting to Taka 20,15,209.60 (Taka twenty lac fifteen thousand two hundred nine and Paisa sixty) only as calculated on 30.6.1991. The said suit was decreed on 10.11.1993, the preliminary decree was signed on 17.11.1993 and the final decree on 27.6.1994. 

 Thereafter the decree holder-bank put the decree in execution by filing Mortgage Execution Case No. 14 of 1995 in Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong on 19.4.1995. After enforcement of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 (herein after referred to ‘the Ain’), the said execution case was transferred to newly constituted Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong for disposal and was admitted on renumbering as Artha Rin Execution Case No.741 of 2003 by order dated 1.7.2003. In course of proceedings in the said execution case, the decree holder-bank filed an application for passing an order of civil imprisonment against the judgment debtor and to issue warrant of arrest against him. The executing Court allowed the said application by order dated 30.5.2005 and issued warrant of arrest against the judgment debtor (herein petitioner) to put him in civil prison. Being aggrieved by the said order, the petitioner moved this Court under article 102 of the Constitution, obtained the Rule and an order of stay.
